fc1737e6fa71: <span1>Fast, open, elegant document and image preview.</span1> <span2>Any PDF, including forms, annotations and encryption. Markdown files, most image formats, including RAW and SVG. Review, annotate, sign and redact by yourself, or using your favourite AI model or agent tools.</span2>
6d94e49a3888: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, camera RAW and more. Crop, rotate, resize and adjust colour with undo, mark up, and export to nine formats. Edits keep EXIF and colour profiles.
840981ec0887: Committers and reviewers: the members of the scrambletoolsllc GitHub organisation, who review every outside contribution before it is merged.
6263ca064f9a: Approvers: the owner of the scrambletoolsllc GitHub organisation, who alone can publish a release, and with it a signing.
3d014d05326a: Highlight, underline and strikethrough over selected text, in five colours.
05fe1d0ecdfd: Border colour, fill colour, line width and dashes for shapes.
b5cc1a2bb26c: Draw with the mouse, a pen or the touchpad. Choose the ink colour and the pen's thickness under the pad; changing them redraws what you signed.
f7b2dc834f59: prev opens PNG, JPEG, GIF (animated too), WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, ICO, TGA, PNM, QOI, JPEG 2000, OpenEXR, Radiance HDR and camera RAW. RAW photos open looking like the JPEG the camera would have made: prev compares the RAW with the small JPEG preview the camera stores in the file and gives it the same brightness, contrast and colour balance. The toolbar rotates, flips, crops and resizes (Adjust Size). Adjust Colour (Ctrl+Shift+C) has exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint, sepia, sharpness and levels. Undo and redo are on the toolbar. The <a1>inspector</a1> (Ctrl+I) shows the file and camera details and can remove location info and edit keywords and a description. Export asks for the format (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, TGA, QOI, PPM or OpenEXR) and, for JPEG, the quality, then where to save; the choices are kept for the next export from the window. Drop more image files on the window to add them to its thumbnail sidebar.
7f0b4404f7cb: Images take markup too: the Markup button (Ctrl+Shift+A) brings up the same markup bar as PDFs, with Sketch, Draw, shapes, text boxes, notes and signatures. Markup stays while the window is open and can be moved, restyled and undone; rotating, cropping and colour changes wait until it is gone. Paste works on images too, and starts the markup if there is none yet. Export draws it into the pixels of the copy you save, at the image's full resolution. Closing the window, or quitting, with markup you haven't exported asks first, with a button to export.
1f4ce983b6c4: Markdown files show with tables, task lists, syntax highlighted code and images, and reload when the file changes on disk. The toolbar makes the text larger or smaller (Ctrl+= and Ctrl+-, Ctrl+0 for the normal size), searches the document (Ctrl+F, then Enter or the arrows for the next and previous match) and opens the <a1>inspector</a1> with the file's details and word count. Code is coloured to suit the light or dark look, and pictures show at their own size, shrunk only to fit the page. Export saves the whole document as one picture, in any of the image formats, at its actual size or twice as sharp; very long documents are scaled down to fit the 16,383 pixel height some formats allow.
260a2eb0e0e1: It goes on the page as an image, centred where you let go, at its own size (96 pixels to the inch), made smaller if it is larger than 80% of the page. Several image files open together in an image window
52bcdea84978: A new page at the line, the size of the page before it, with the image as large as fits, centred
915e861e0332: Edit: rotate, delete, move, insert and crop pages, fill form fields, place pictures, and crop, rotate, resize and adjust the colour of images. A model that changes an image, such as to remove its background, takes it from prev and hands back the changed one, and prev keeps the image as it was among its versions.
fa337edf900c: Settings opens over the current window, from the gear button at the end of the toolbar or Ctrl+,. Close it with its close button, Escape or a click outside it. Changes apply to every window at once. Its five tabs are General, with the languages and the default app; Appearance, with light or dark, colours and how windows look; Assistant, with the models for <a1>the assistant</a1>; Agents, for <a2>AI agents</a2>; and Storage, with where prev keeps your files:
20d3b64ec5ff: Use the system accent color: colours are built from the system's accent colour: the desktop theme's on Linux, and the one set in Windows' or macOS's settings. Off, or where the system has none, a row of colours below it picks the colour instead; prev's blue is the first.
acbdb47af4de: prev follows the system's light or dark setting and reduced motion setting, and its accent colour. It looks the same on Windows and macOS, in each system's own window; on the Mac its menus are in the menu bar, and its shortcuts use ⌘ instead of Ctrl. In narrow windows, toolbar groups that don't fit move into a More menu, which closes as soon as you choose something from it (a button that opens its own menu, such as Pages, keeps it open under that menu). The search field grows into whatever room the toolbar has left.
d28357d29bc2: A photo open with the Adjust Colour panel
e33a7cf2935c: An agent pointing out the largest expense: the drip irrigation row of the budget's expenses table, outlined in the accent colour
80e5b3da05ba: The Appearance tab of Settings: light or dark, the accent colour, and how windows look
c9283a58313e: Material Design 3, light or dark and the accent colour from the system
81b71dc9405b: EXIF, ICC colour profiles and XMP kept through edits in JPEG, PNG, WebP and TIFF; keywords and descriptions saved to JPEG, PNG and WebP; location removable
ab778d5a85aa: All open source, with licences checked by cargo-deny in CI; GPL-2.0-only is refused
fdb9a990a9df: GNU AGPL-3.0 or later, as MuPDF requires; the bundled fonts keep their own licences (SIL Open Font License 1.1, Apache 2.0)
499581862a15: Text box and Note, with fonts, sizes, colours and alignment. While you type in a text box, a bar above it makes the selected text bold (Ctrl+B), italic (Ctrl+I) or another colour.
ca87760a51b1: The assistant is a chat beside your document: ask about the file and it reads what it needs, shows you where things are, and works in the file for you with the same tools as an <a1>AI agent</a1>. The robot head on the toolbar, before the markup button, opens it on the right. Each window has its own chat, kept while the panel is closed; New Chat starts over, and Stop ends an answer under way. When a chat grows longer than a local model can read at once, its earlier part is summarised so the chat can go on, and the panel says so.
e93a54438d64: Highlight, underline, strikethrough; sketch, draw; rectangle, rounded rectangle, oval, line, arrow, star, polygon, speech bubble, loupe, mask; text boxes, with bold, italic and coloured parts, and notes. Saved as standard PDF annotations
